Cafe Stella Roasters SWOT & Event Analysis

Background/Introduction

Cafe Stella Roasters is a family-owned, local coffee roasting company and bistro at 1907 Colonial Avenue in historic Ghent neighborhood of Norfolk, Virginia. Well-known for its Old World-style ambiance...

SWOT Analysis

Strengths

  • In-House Coffee Roasting
  • Varying Menu Options
  • Community Engagement in the Form of Live Music

Weaknesses

  • Restricted Parking Area
  • Unreliable Customer Service
  • Congested During Peak Hours

Opportunities

  • Expansion of Catering Services
  • Expanded Online Platform and Ordering
  • Local Artisan Partnerships

Threats

  • Intense Local Competition
  • Economic Depressions
  • Changing Consumer Tastes

Event Recommendation

To further position itself as a community hub... host a "Local Artisans Market"...

Target Market

  • Local residents of all ages
  • Adventure-seeking tourists

Location and Logistics

The market would take place on Cafe Stella's property...

Most Likely Benefits

  • Stronger Community Connections
  • Increased Sales and Foot Traffic
  • Increased Brand Image
